title: Spotify is disrupting the music industry. But don't expect it to displace the Big 3 music labels anytime soon - here's why (SPOT, AAPL, SNE)
text: Spotify is disrupting the music industry. But don't expect it to displace the Big 3 music labels anytime soon — here's why (SPOT, AAPL, SNE) By Troy Wolverton Sep 24, 2018, 7:38 pm 32 pts Spotify has been making waves in the music industry by trying to sign up independent artists. But don't expect the company to replace the major recording labels anytime soon, UBS analysts said in a new report.
